facts.text: I don't see the point of making modern adaptations of Jane Austen's novels.
I believe the original texts are famous for a reason.
I think modern adaptations run the risk of completely changing the meaning and essence of the original text.
I think modern adaptations use Jane Austen's name and reputation to sell a new product rather than truly honoring her work.
